card.name: Digits inside citation and catalog numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a longer number in a reference, such as a volume, page, DOI, URL, call number or Dewey number. It fires on the digit before the number ends.

modes.label: Citation numbers
modes.description: Digit inside a journal volume, issue, page or DOI number.

modes.label: Catalog and URL numbers
modes.description: Digit inside a library classification, Dewey number or web address.

card.plain: It marks a digit partway through a reference number, like a page, volume or catalog number.
